summary: Dow falls 1,000+ points wiping out 3-day gains; Nasdaq -30%, S&P -19%. Target -25%, Walmart -18% in two days. SGX implies 500-pt gap-down on expiry day; speaker warns put sellers of mayhem, compares fall to 1987/2000/2008.

events.claim: Dow fell more than 1,000 points on 18-May-2022, first 1,000+ fall of 2022; Dow down 7 straight weeks
Target shares fell 25% on disappointing results (energy/employee costs); Walmart fell 18% over two sessions
UK inflation at 9%, a 40-year high (data out 18-May-2022)
Warren Buffett bought a large stake in Citibank (reported ~May-2022)

lessons: When everything looks hopeless, that is often where bottoms form - but only with confirmation.
Comparison-to-past-crashes narratives (1987/2000/2008/2020) mark capitulation phases.
quote: Now they start comparing this fall with the 1987 crash... the market is completely in bear control.

summary: Opened 2% lower, one-way fall after 11am broke 15,900; IT index -6% with all five IT majors down 5%+; Bank Nifty -1,000 intraday; only ITC, Dr Reddy, Power Grid green. FII May selling 43,000cr - highest in two years. Speaker's MTM loss over 1 crore.

events.claim: FII sold 4,900cr on 19-May; 43,000cr in May month, 46,000cr in May series - highest since pandemic month (65,000cr in Mar-2020)
IT index fell ~6% on 19-May-2022; Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCL Tech, Tech Mahindra all down 5%+
Mutual fund lumpsum inflows fell 44% last month (April 2022)
Nasdaq down 30% from peak as of 19-May-2022; Dow broke 52-week low

lessons: Institutions opened the day's selling at 11am - mid-session one-way moves signal institutional exit.
A support hammered repeatedly (15,800) weakens like metal under a hammer until it breaks.
quote: Thursday to Thursday the market closed exactly one point higher... that is indecision.
leaks: 'you can see from my face... my MTM loss was more than a crore' (personal P&L on identity)

summary: 225-pt gap-up with no fresh good news after brutal gap-down; speaker distrusts it, cites 80% gap-fade rule, plans to cut positions. Rupee 75->78 in two months; FII 71% short. Auto stocks (Hero MotoCorp, Maruti) notably resilient.

events.claim: Study claim: 80% of time huge gap-ups are sold into and huge gap-downs bought into
Indian rupee depreciated from ~75 to ~77-78 per USD within two months (Mar-May 2022)
FIIs held 71% short position in index futures around 20-May-2022

lessons: Gap-ups without news tend to be sold into; only news-driven gaps sustain and trend.
Flat openings can set the day's major trend; violent gaps rarely trend without news.
quote: Only two things are certain in this market - one is volatility, the other one is FII selling.
dup_flag: gap behaviour theme repeats from 1024 predecessors
leaks: 'Nirmala Sitharaman candle' (FM name, public role - acceptable)

summary: Powerful surprise short-covering rally: China home-loan rate cut triggered global rally; opened ~16,000, closed ~16,280. Reliance +6% alone gave 120 Nifty points. Dow's 8th straight weekly fall - first since 1932. Speaker flipped from call-selling losses to buying calls.

events.claim: China cut interest rate on home loans (5-year LPR) on 20-May-2022, triggering global short covering
Dow Jones fell for 8 consecutive weeks to 20-May-2022 - first such streak since 1932
Reliance rose 6% on 20-May-2022, contributing ~120 points of Nifty's gain

lessons: Short-covering rallies are sharper and faster than bull-market rallies.
A 24-hour window can invert a view entirely - size positions so inversion is survivable.
quote: Yesterday I gave a totally bearish view, today a totally bullish view - this is what market is all about.
leaks: 'offline workshop in Mumbai... may be my last workshop... contact our office' (workshop promo)

summary: Excise-cut/LPG-subsidy announcements vs ~1 lakh crore revenue loss debate; metals, cement, banks in focus. Reliance demerger rumors simmer after +6%. SGX swung 300 points over weekend. Range view 16,000-16,400 into Thursday expiry.

events.claim: Finance ministry announced fuel tax cut (excise), LPG subsidy and steel/cement logistics measures on 21-May-2022; estimated revenue loss over 1 lakh crore
Reliance rose 6% on 20-May-2022 amid Jio/Retail demerger speculation
FII short position in index futures reduced to ~61% by 23-May-2022

lessons: Tax cuts funded by borrowing merely shift the burden - real relief comes only from falling international crude.
Keep positions light into a fourth consecutive high-volatility week.
quote: Government cutting taxes but losing revenue to borrow elsewhere - both are not good.

summary: Treacherous session: 200-pt moves in first 20 minutes, rallied through 16,400, then 2pm US-futures dip triggered FII selling - Bank Nifty -800, Nifty -200 in ~100 minutes. Metals crashed 10-20% on export restrictions. HDFC twins conspicuously flat = warning.

events.claim: Metals stocks fell 10-20% on 23-May-2022 after India imposed export restrictions/duties on steel and iron ore products
Nifty crossed the 16,399 swing high intraday on 23-May then reversed on ~2pm FII selling

lessons: After 2pm, institutional selling hits regularly - the last 90 minutes carry structural risk in high-VIX regimes.
When index heavyweights refuse to rise while the index does, the breakout is suspect.
quote: After 2pm this kind of selling has been happening many times.

summary: US futures fell overnight with no news - nature of high-volatility markets. FII May selling >46,000cr = second highest ever after Mar-2020 (65,000cr); no single net-buy day all series. Next-month futures at discount to current month - speaker has never seen this before expiry.

events.claim: FII May-2022 cash selling crossed 46,000 crore - second highest month ever after March 2020 (65,000cr); not one net-buying day in the series
Next-month (June) Nifty future traded at a discount to current month in late May 2022 - described as unprecedented barring expiry day

lessons: When only bad news reaches you, bottoms are being made; when only good news, tops.
All futures months below spot signals extreme bearish positioning - respect the warning.
quote: Whenever you hear only bad news, that is when markets bottom out.
leaks: 'this is P. R. Sundar's golden words'
'I do have 34,500 short straddle in bank Nifty' (personal position)

summary: Inside-candle low broken: 16,035 low after 400-pt slide; HDFC twins flipped to top gainers, Kotak +10% in five sessions. India VIX spiked ~10% for no news - premium-driven fear. Heavy call writing 16,100-16,400 with little put writing = upside risk.

events.claim: Kotak Bank rallied ~10% (1,750 to 1,920) in 4-5 sessions while the broader market fell (mid/late May 2022)
India VIX spiked nearly 10% on 24-May-2022 without any specific news

lessons: VIX spikes near expiry inflate premiums - option writers face trap risk in both directions.
An inside candle that fails (level broken) resolves directionally - trade the break, not the guess.
quote: Wicks shooting up means the markets are likely to make a bigger move.
leaks: 'I am not a CB registered analyst' disclaimer
'my stop loss... I do have long positions' (personal)

summary: Snap -40% on results crushed tech: Facebook -25%, Netflix -25%, Google -8%; Dow -500 then recovered to green. 16,000 held (16,035); shorts covering as futures discount narrowed. FII afternoon selling now 'regular custom'; Kali-temple joke on five-month selling comparisons.

events.claim: Snap fell more than 40% on 24-May-2022 results; Google fell 8%; Meta/Netflix down ~25% from highs, dragging tech
US 10-year bond yield fell ~4% (relative) and dollar index eased around 24-25 May 2022
Claim circulating: FIIs withdrew in 5 months (Jan-May 2022) roughly what they invested over the prior 12 years

lessons: When nobody wants to buy, even small selling drags the market disproportionately.
Intraday event-trading (post-1pm FII flow) can be structured with limited risk - but only as a studied, disclaimed tactic.
quote: Last week it was Target, this week it was Snap.

summary: Gap-up sold; entire ~100-pt fall from Infosys, TCS, Asian Paints (Grasim paint-entry news, -8%) and L&T. FII May selling crossed 50,000cr; Jan-May 2,75,000cr ≈ 12-13 years of FII inflows withdrawn in five months. Fed minutes (nothing new) soothed US.

events.claim: Asian Paints fell ~8% intraday on 25-May-2022 on news Grasim would enter paints with large capacity
FII May-2022 cash selling crossed 50,000 crore; Jan-May 2022 cumulative ~2,75,000 crore - equal to their prior 12-13 years of net inflows
Fed minutes released 25-May-2022 showed preference for 50bp hikes, no 75bp advocate; Nasdaq recovered from -2.5% to +1.5%
China began reopening schools/colleges from COVID lockdowns (late May 2022)

lessons: Index declines concentrate in few names - tracking heavyweight contribution explains most index moves.
Do not catch the falling knife without conviction; trading in such regimes is harder than investing.
quote: Whatever FIIs brought in 12 years, almost the entire amount has been taken away in five months.

summary: Fed minutes reassured (50bp path, no 75bp advocate); China reopening. Three negatives diluting: US rates, China lockdown, Russia-Ukraine - longer-term bottom near. Kotak +10% in 4-5 sessions; Bank Nifty flat 3 sessions. May FII selling likely to set record 55-60,000cr.

events.claim: Fed minutes (25-May-2022): members preferred 50bp hikes in coming meetings; no case made for 75bp
Kotak Bank +10% in 4-5 sessions (1,750→1,920) late May 2022; HDFC twins top Nifty contributors two sessions running
March 2020 FII selling 65,000cr remains the record; May 2022 already >50,000cr with 4 sessions left

lessons: In VIX>25 regimes, the close-at-extreme trick (day-low close → buy calls; day-high close → buy puts) captures overnight sentiment flips.
Bottoms form when the three dominant negatives are all diluting simultaneously.
quote: If you dare to lose it all in one trade: market closes at lowest point of the day - buy calls.

summary: Expiry mayhem: gap-up faded, futures broke 15,900, then a 500-pt swing with a powerful short-covering rally to ~16,200. Bank Nifty green all morning; SBI +5% low-to-high; PSU banks surged. May series: Nifty lost 1,000+ points; FII series selling >53,000cr.

events.claim: Nifty fell ~200 points then rallied ~300 from the low on 26-May-2022 expiry - a ~500-point intraday swing
May 2022 series: Nifty lost more than 1,000 points; FII sold >53,000cr in the series (second highest ever)
SBI rallied 5% from intraday low to high on 26-May-2022; PSU bank index surged

lessons: Volatile expiries initially favour bears but can reverse violently - never assume the first move is the day's move.
Trend followers need a clean break: above 16,400 or below 15,700, the range-bound churn is untradeable.
quote: From 15,900 it went to 16,200 - such a powerful short covering rally.

summary: US GDP -1.5% (worse than expected) yet Dow +1.6%, Nasdaq +2.68% - ignoring bad news = bottoming signal. June series begins with normal positioning (FII 45% long) vs May's 83% short start; rollovers higher. Bank Nifty broke 35,000; PSU banks lead; IT oversold.

events.claim: US Q1-2022 GDP revised to -1.5% annualized (worse than -1.3% expected) on 26-May-2022; Dow +1.6%, Nasdaq +2.68% same day
FIIs began May series 83% short in index futures; begin June series ~45% long / 55% short
Bank Nifty decisively crossed 35,000 on 27-May-2022; SBI +5% low-to-high previous day

lessons: Markets ignore bad news near bottoms and ignore good news near tops - watch the reaction, not the headline.
Option writers need gradual moves more than they need direction.
quote: When markets start ignoring bad news, the bottom is somewhere near or already made.
leaks: 'Talal street next month program' (ASR of Dalal Street Week Ahead)

summary: Stability returned: first calm session after mayhem. Four bottom signals: US stability, bad-GDP ignored, FII futures 55% short (comfortable), India VIX -15% in two sessions. News of windfall tax on oil producers (Reliance, ONGC) made them top drags. Speaker confidently selling puts again.

events.claim: Government reportedly planning additional tax on oil producers (Reliance, ONGC) to offset excise cut revenue loss (news 27-May-2022; windfall tax later imposed 1-Jul-2022)
India VIX fell ~15% across 26-27 May 2022; crude at $114-115
FII sold 2,000cr on 27-May; DIIs bought 2,700cr

lessons: Four-way confirmation (price stability + news ignored + positioning normal + VIX collapse) marks a durable bottom attempt.
Sell options only when gradual two-way movement returns - not merely because the index is rising.
quote: After a long time I am comfortable with the market... confidently selling put options.
leaks: 'time is getting late for my party' (personal)

summary: Nasdaq +7.5% in three sessions on strong consumer spending; rate-hike expectations easing; dollar index down; China lifting lockdowns. Monsoon hit Kerala 3 days early - rural economy positive. Crude $120 the main negative. FII futures 48% long = comfortable zone.

events.claim: Nasdaq rose ~7.5% over three sessions to 27-May-2022; US consumer spending data strong; dollar index weakened
China began lifting Shanghai COVID lockdown restrictions (late May/June 2022)
Monsoon hit Kerala three days ahead of schedule (29-May-2022)
Crude oil rose to ~$120 (end-May 2022) on China reopening demand

lessons: Markets gap up near resistance and gap down near support - the edge belongs to those positioned a day early.
In an agri economy, early monsoon is a genuine macro positive despite headline distraction.
quote: For the last two weeks Nifty traded 15,700-16,400 and everybody waited to go long only above 16,400.
leaks: 'my capital is big... spread across strikes' (personal)

summary: One-way rally: Thursday 15,900 → Monday 16,674, ~700 points in 12 trading hours. IT + Reliance led (60% of +300 from three stocks); PSU banks +3%; mid/small caps outperformed. India VIX -22% in 3 sessions, below 20. FIIs turned net buyers (+500cr) - first buy day of May.

events.claim: Nifty futures rallied ~700 points from Thursday afternoon low (15,900) to Monday high (16,674), 26-30 May 2022
FIIs turned net buyers (+500cr) on 30-May-2022 - first net-buy day of the month after selling every day since 1 May
India VIX fell ~22% across three sessions to close below 20 (30-May-2022)

lessons: Post-crash rebounds are as powerful as the crash itself - but one day of FII buying against 2.4 lakh crore of selling proves nothing.
Put-writing at 16,300-16,500 OI confirms market-set floors.
quote: Sanity and stability are returning to stock markets - not only in India, all over the world.
leaks: 'hope you enjoyed the market rally as well as watching my video'

summary: China May manufacturing PMI 49.6 beat expectations (48) though still contractionary. Buy-on-dip regime unless 16,000 breaks. Data-heavy week: GDP today, auto sales/GST tomorrow, RBI policy Friday. LIC's weak results and ₹1.50 dividend disappointed; Aurobindo Pharma at ~10 PE despite LIC buying.

events.claim: China May-2022 manufacturing PMI came at 49.6 vs 48 expected (April: 47.4)
LIC reported lower profit and declared ₹1.50/share dividend (results ~30-May-2022), disappointing retail IPO investors
Aurobindo Pharma trades near 10 PE vs pharma peers 30-40, halved to ~500 despite LIC buying at ~650
M&M crossed 1,000 for the first time in 10-15 years after good results (30/31-May-2022)

lessons: Don't over-read a single 500cr FII buy day against 2.4 lakh crore of prior selling.
LIC buying is not a stock-price catalyst - fundamentals outweigh anchor-investor reputations.
quote: Seldom do stocks underperform after LIC buys in huge quantities - Aurobindo is an exception.
leaks: 'I had some short position in Kotak Bank' (personal)

summary: Morning crash -150, recovery +150, then last-hour Bank Nifty -500. FII gross volumes exploded: 45,000cr buy vs 46,000cr sell (net -1,000cr) - 4-5x normal, attributed to MSCI rejig though non-rejig stocks fell too. Eurozone inflation 8.1% vs 7.8% expected. Post-2pm straddle system profitable again.

events.claim: FII gross buy 45,000cr / gross sell 46,000cr on 31-May-2022 - 4-5x normal gross volume, attributed largely to MSCI rebalancing
Eurozone inflation printed 8.1% vs 7.8% expected (31-May-2022)
Kotak Bank fell ~120 points (~5%) over two sessions despite not being a MSCI-rejig stock

lessons: Gross institutional volume spikes (rebalancing flows) explain violent non-news sessions.
The 2pm-3:30pm straddle with stops captured repeated late-day violence in May-2022 - regime-specific tactics work until the regime changes.
quote: It makes sense to do some straddle after 2pm because the markets move violently after 2pm.

summary: US 1,000-pt swing; India -150 first half hour and -150 last half hour; Bank Nifty -500 late. Key difference: US volatile-but-flat monthly, India volatile-and-losing. Overnight everything green without reason (crude -$4) - value-buying sign. After-2pm straddle system repeated.

events.claim: Dow futures swung ~1,000 points on 31-May-2022 (-500 to 0 to -250)
India: Nifty -150 in first 30 minutes and -150 in last 30 minutes on 31-May-2022; Bank Nifty -500 in the last half hour
FII gross sell volume 46,000cr+ (~$7bn) on 31-May attributed to MSCI rejig

lessons: Compare like-for-like: US volatility resolved flat for the month while India bled - regime strength differs even when daily noise looks identical.
Green markets without a reason can signal genuine value-buying returning.
quote: Instead of stability and sanity, it is only Satan returning to haunt the markets.

summary: 'Saitan market' continues: -200 intraday, +100 recovery; futures low 16,425 held the 16,400 support. IT dragged (Infosys alone a third of the -60 fall) despite Nasdaq recovery; Bank Nifty outperformed with +400 in the last half hour (opposite of yesterday's -500). Heavy call writing, little put writing = upside risk.

events.claim: Infosys alone contributed about one-third of Nifty's ~60-point fall on 1-Jun-2022
Bank Nifty fell 500 points in the last half hour on 31-May and rose 400 points in the last half hour on 1-Jun - opposite closes
FII sold 1,900cr on 1-Jun-2022 on low gross volume; DIIs bought roughly half that

lessons: When calls are written aggressively and puts are not, the trap risk sits on the upside - map open interest asymmetry before expiry.
April made April fools, May was mayhem - series-personality labels help traders set expectations.
quote: Every day we will be having stress... but we will live forever happily.
leaks: 'I am selling put option from 15,700 and below' (personal strategy)

summary: US fell 2nd day but US VIX fell 2% - fear not rising, move already factored. India again opened above a big SGX gap-down indication. 16,400 = gap-fill zone/former resistance. Broader market outperforming; HDFC twins strong. Expiry-day 3pm 'hero or zero' playbook offered.

events.claim: US markets fell for a second consecutive day (1-Jun-2022) but US VIX fell ~2% - suggesting the decline was factored in
Kotak Bank saw basket selling (~2 days before 2-Jun) blamed for Bank Nifty's 500-point late fall on 31-May

lessons: A falling market with a non-spiking VIX is consolidation, not panic - the trend rarely extends.
Violent moves occur when option sellers are trapped; a gap-down that untraps sellers loses momentum.
quote: The markets make very violent moves only when option sellers are trapped.

summary: Third straight SGX-fade: opened higher, tested SGX low, then +215 low-to-high; closed +105 with 75% from Reliance + Infosys. All sectors green except financials; HDFC twins flipped to top drags. Next-week OI shows calls AND puts written 16,100-17,000 = sellers expect consolidation.

events.claim: Nifty closed +105 on 2-Jun-2022 with ~75% of the rally from Reliance and Infosys alone
All sectoral indices closed green except financials on 2-Jun-2022
16,400 support tested twice (16,425/16,430) and held on 31-May and 1-Jun-2022

lessons: Turnaround vs relief rally: hold the view conditionally - bullish above 16,400 short-term, above 15,700 long-term.
Call sellers trapped at a top get flushed by short covering - that mechanical squeeze, not news, drove the crossing of 16,600.
quote: I will not be bearish short-term as long as 16,400 is held, nor long-term as long as 15,700 holds.
leaks: 'I bought 17,000 put and sold five times 16,400 put' (personal)
'I have to go out for my dinner' (personal)

summary: Dow -300 to +450 overnight (750-pt swing); Microsoft warning faded; cloud stocks +10-12% on value buying (PE 15→8). US ignores bad news repeatedly = bottoming behaviour. 16,800 milestone: broke down through it in early May, now reclaimed (+1,100 from 15,700). Consensus 12-14K targets = contrarian bullish.

events.claim: Dow swung from -300 to +450 (~750 points) overnight into 3-Jun-2022; Microsoft's growth warning faded and cloud-computing stocks rose 10-12%
Cloud-computing companies' average PE compressed from ~15 to ~8 (roughly -50%) before the late-May/early-Jun 2022 rebound
TCS fell from ~4,000 to ~3,200 (~-20%) and Infosys -20%+ from highs by early June 2022

lessons: Consensus is dangerous: when every target is 12,000-14,000, the rally surprises.
The 2008 rule of thumb inverted: $1B of FII selling once meant -4-5%; in 2022 even $40B produced under -20% - retail changed market physics.
quote: Consensus is dangerous in the stock market - everybody bearish is exactly when markets rally.

summary: 200-pt gap-up 'without any reason' sold into all day; Bank Nifty collapsed ~750 high-to-low (ICICI -15, SBI -10) on a good global day. Range 16,400-16,800 confirmed, closed 16,600 midpoint. Aggressive call writing 16,600-17,000 after the turn. US jobs data the weekend wildcard.

events.claim: Bank Nifty fell ~750 points from intraday high to low on 3-Jun-2022; ICICI Bank -15, SBI -10
FII sold 3,800cr on 3-Jun-2022; DIIs bought 2,400cr
Reliance traded near all-time high on Jio/Retail demerger speculation despite the broader market being 10-15% off highs

lessons: Huge gap-ups invite FII selling; huge gap-downs invite DII support - the absorption asymmetry frames the week.
When call writing clusters right after a turn, the crowd expects a capped market - fade-proof your own bias.
quote: If the gap up will be sold into and gap down bought into, that asymmetry is the whole strategy.
leaks: 'hope you enjoyed listening to this audio'

summary: Nasdaq -2.5% on strong jobs data (rate fears) but US VIX calm - move factored. Crude $120 on China reopening. Of 7 heavyweights, 4 financials face RBI-policy uncertainty, 2 IT weak - bulls rely on Reliance alone. Range-trade setup: long 16,410/short 16,800 with tight stops.

events.claim: Nasdaq fell ~2.5% (~350 points) on 3-Jun-2022 after strong US jobs data raised rate-hike expectations
Crude oil shot up to $120 (early June 2022) on China reopening demand
FII sold 3,800cr on Friday 3-Jun-2022, the largest daily sell in over a week

lessons: In pessimism-optimism swing regimes, trade the range ends: long near support, short near resistance, tight stops.
The heavyweight scoreboard (4 financials + 2 IT weak, Reliance carrying) tells you how fragile an index rally is.
quote: The market is all about short and short covering, long unwinding - that is why volatility is so huge.
